landing.demoDescription: Try it yourself. Our tracking system is fast and responsive. Click the button on the right side to simulate an episode's progress.
landing.favorites: Display your top favorites on your profile
landing.upload: Upload your screenshots and show to your friends
landing.related: View related animes, sequels, prequels and franchises
landing.settings: Personalized settings for notifications and display.
landing.toastCongrats: Congrats! You finished this TV show.
landing.CTADescription: Join other geeks organizing your favorite media today!
landing.heroDescription: The ultimate tracker for anime, games, movies, TV shows, manga, and books. Discover stats, connect with friends, and never lose track of your progress. Open-source, self-hostable, and free.
landing.featuresTitle: All your needs in one place
landing.featuresDescription: Stop juggling multiple apps and spreadsheets.
landing.animeMangaDescription: One of the largest anime and manga catalogs, with access to relations, characters, and detailed information.
landing.moviesTVShowsDescription: Get access to a rich catalog of movies and TV shows, with franchise views and notifications for new releases or upcoming episodes.
landing.advancedProgressDescription: Highlight key details of your content, add notes, and write a complete review at the end.
landing.socialFeedDescription: See what your friends are up to and share your thoughts with them.
landing.gamesDescription: A gaming fan who needs to better organize their library? Track playtime, overall game progress, and multiple completion statuses.
landing.booksDescription: For the more literary-minded, we offer an option as well. Track pages read and how many times you’ve reread a book.
